event.description: Remove all remaining LayerNorm affine scales as well as offsets while retaining affine-free LayerNorm statistics, cross-layer norm sharing, reversed operands, d=14, two heads, two blocks, ff=19, rank-3 positions, and the 45000-step schedule.
event.proposal: Family: normalization. Retained incumbent is 3031 parameters at 99.990000%, a +0.990000 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family history: the most recent accepted result is attempt-0041, offset-free shared LayerNorm (3031, 99.99%); the most recent failed result is attempt-0016, offset-free LayerNorm in the earlier forward-order/rank-8 setup, an optimization failure; 4 prior normalization attempts. Hypothesis: the three shared LayerNorm scales may also be unnecessary once offsets have been successfully removed, while the centering and variance statistic remain active; this removes 42 actual learned scalars, reducing 3031 to 2989. This is parameterization-preserving normalization compression, not a representational substitution. It is more informative than replacing LayerNorm with RMSNorm because it directly isolates all affine parameters while retaining the same mean-and-variance normalization statistic.
